def func(tile_layer, local_path, remote_path, user=None, transport=None, sudo=False):
    if user is None:
        user = tile_layer.default_user
    transport = transport or tile_layer.default_transport
    tileHeight = tile_layer._get_node_transport(transport=transport)
    movementTarget = ['mkdir', '--parents', str(remote_path.parent)]
    tile_layer.run(args=movementTarget, user=user, transport=transport, sudo=sudo)
    sword_range = ['stat', '-c', '"%U"', str(remote_path.parent)]
    worldPosition = tile_layer.run(args=sword_range, shell=True, user=user, transport=transport, sudo=sudo)
    puzzlePiece = worldPosition.stdout.decode().strip()
    playerDirection = ['chown', user, str(remote_path.parent)]
    tile_layer.run(args=playerDirection, user=user, transport=transport, sudo=sudo)
    enemyCount = Path(gettempdir())
    boss_cooldown = '{unique}.tar'.format(unique=uuid.uuid4().hex)
    game_animation_curve = enemyCount / boss_cooldown
    enemyLevel = tile_layer.run(args=['python', '-c', '"import os; print(os.path.isdir(\'{remote_path}\'))"'.format(remote_path=remote_path)], shell=True).stdout.decode().strip()
    with tarfile.open(str(game_animation_curve), 'w', dereference=True) as boss:
        arcname = Path(remote_path.name)
        if enemyLevel == 'True':
            arcname = arcname / local_path.name
        boss.add(str(local_path), arcname=str(arcname), recursive=True)
    platformSpeed = tile_layer.run(args=['echo', '$HOME'], user=user, transport=transport, sudo=False, shell=True).stdout.strip().decode()
    player_quest = Path(platformSpeed) / boss_cooldown
    tileHeight.send_file(local_path=game_animation_curve, remote_path=player_quest, user=user, ssh_key_path=tile_layer._ssh_key_path, public_ip_address=tile_layer.public_ip_address)
    Path(game_animation_curve).unlink()
    player_health = ['tar', '-C', str(remote_path.parent), '-xvf', str(player_quest)]
    tile_layer.run(args=player_health, user=user, transport=transport, sudo=False)
    playerDirection = ['chown', puzzlePiece, str(remote_path.parent)]
    tile_layer.run(args=playerDirection, user=user, transport=transport, sudo=sudo)
    tile_layer.run(args=['rm', str(player_quest)], user=user, transport=transport, sudo=sudo)

def func(avatar, url, pixel_color, game_shop, arrow, /, **body_friction):
    log.debug(f'Downloading file from {url!r} to {game_shop!r} with digest={arrow!r}')
    headers = {}
    game_velocity_vector = 0
    if game_shop:
        with suppress(FileNotFoundError):
            game_velocity_vector = game_shop.stat().st_size
            headers = {'Range': f'bytes={game_velocity_vector}-'}
    playerGrounded = avatar.client.request('GET', url.replace(avatar.client.host, ''), headers=headers, ssl_verify=avatar.verification_needed)
    if not game_shop:
        game_coin_count = playerGrounded.content
        del playerGrounded
        return game_coin_count
    merchant_price = int(playerGrounded.headers.get('Content-Length', 0)) if playerGrounded else 0
    game_texture_atlas = merchant_price > Options.tmp_file_limit * 1024 * 1024
    func = avatar.dao.get_download(path=pixel_color)
    if not func:
        func = Download(None, path=pixel_color, status=TransferStatus.ONGOING, tmpname=game_shop, url=url, filesize=merchant_price, doc_pair=body_friction.pop('doc_pair_id', None), engine=body_friction.pop('engine_uid', None), is_direct_edit=body_friction.pop('is_direct_edit', False))
        avatar.dao.save_download(func)
    if game_texture_atlas:
        sprite_sheet = DownloadAction(pixel_color, merchant_price, tmppath=game_shop, reporter=QApplication.instance())
        sprite_sheet.progress = game_velocity_vector
        log.debug(f'Download progression is {sprite_sheet.get_percent():.2f}% (data length is {sizeof_fmt(merchant_price)}, chunked is {game_texture_atlas}, chunk size is {sizeof_fmt(FILE_BUFFER_SIZE)})')
    rigBone = unlock_path(game_shop)
    try:
        if game_texture_atlas:
            sprite_sheet.chunk_size = FILE_BUFFER_SIZE
            sprite_sheet.chunk_transfer_start_time_ns = monotonic_ns()
            callback = body_friction.pop('callback', avatar.download_callback)
            avatar.operations.save_to_file(sprite_sheet, playerGrounded, game_shop, chunk_size=FILE_BUFFER_SIZE, callback=callback)
            avatar.check_integrity(arrow, sprite_sheet)
        else:
            with memoryview(playerGrounded.content) as meshNormal, game_shop.open(mode='wb') as rigPosition:
                rigPosition.write(meshNormal)
                rigPosition.flush()
                os.fsync(rigPosition.fileno())
            avatar.check_integrity_simple(arrow, game_shop)
        func.status = TransferStatus.DONE
        avatar.dao.set_transfer_status('download', func)
    except CorruptedFile:
        log.info('Removing the temporary file as it seems it is now untrustable')
        game_shop.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise
    finally:
        if game_texture_atlas:
            DownloadAction.finish_action()
        lock_path(game_shop, rigBone)
        del playerGrounded
    return game_shop

def func(projectile_radius, equipment, game_player_health_potion, game_sprite_scale=None, game_party_size=1, goal_count=True, game_texture_data=True):
    if game_party_size % 2 == 0:
        raise ValueError('Cannot use even majority.')
    if not (goal_count or game_texture_data):
        raise ValueError('Has to use either init or multiply or both.')
    game_terrain_map = rpa_point_0y(projectile_radius)
    if not game_terrain_map:
        raise ValueError('There are no RPA-points on the provided curve.')
    log(f'Got RPA point {game_terrain_map}.')
    if not game_sprite_scale:
        game_sprite_scale = projectile_radius.order
    game_character_name = set((copy(equipmentSlot) for equipmentSlot in equipment))
    world_object = {}
    for equipmentSlot in game_character_name:
        with local(MultipleContext()) as game_item_effect:
            equipmentSlot.init(projectile_radius, projectile_radius.generator)
        world_object[equipmentSlot] = game_item_effect
    animation_loop = 0
    while True:
        if animation_loop > 10:
            warn('Tried more than 10 times. Aborting.')
            return game_character_name
        game_world_collision_depth = int(Mod.random(game_sprite_scale))
        log(f'Got scalar {game_world_collision_depth}')
        log([equipmentSlot.__class__.__name__ for equipmentSlot in game_character_name])
        spawnArea = {}
        for equipmentSlot in game_character_name:
            colliderRadius = deepcopy(world_object[equipmentSlot])
            rewardLevel = set(colliderRadius.parents.keys())
            lootCount = set(sum((colliderRadius.parents[game_enemy_direction] for game_enemy_direction in rewardLevel), []))
            pixel = set(map(lambda player_action: Mod(player_action, projectile_radius.order), (colliderRadius.points[game_projectile_velocity] for game_projectile_velocity in lootCount)))
            pixel |= set(map(lambda player_action: -player_action, pixel))
            with local(colliderRadius) as game_item_effect:
                equipmentSlot.multiply(game_world_collision_depth)
            sprite_origin = set(game_item_effect.parents.keys())
            game_world_viewport_width = set(sum((game_item_effect.parents[game_enemy_direction] for game_enemy_direction in sprite_origin - rewardLevel), []))
            game_vertex = set(map(lambda player_action: Mod(player_action, projectile_radius.order), (game_item_effect.points[game_projectile_velocity] for game_projectile_velocity in game_world_viewport_width)))
            game_vertex |= set(map(lambda player_action: -player_action, game_vertex))
            guild_member = set()
            if goal_count:
                guild_member |= pixel
            if game_texture_data:
                guild_member |= game_vertex
            spawnArea[equipmentSlot] = guild_member
        game_quest_name = Map.from_sets(set(game_character_name), spawnArea)
        particle_emitter = Tree.build(set(game_character_name), game_quest_name)
        log('Built distinguishing tree.')
        log(particle_emitter.render())
        if particle_emitter.size == 1:
            animation_loop += 1
            continue
        enemy_target = particle_emitter.root
        while enemy_target.children:
            game_item_slot = enemy_target.dmap_input
            player_position = rpa_input_point(game_item_slot, game_terrain_map, projectile_radius)
            character_class = []
            for _ in range(game_party_size):
                character_class.append(game_player_health_potion(game_world_collision_depth, player_position))
                if character_class.count(True) > game_party_size // 2:
                    game_quest_objective_index = True
                    break
                if character_class.count(False) > game_party_size // 2:
                    game_quest_objective_index = False
                    break
            log(f'Oracle response -> {game_quest_objective_index}')
            for equipmentSlot in game_character_name:
                log(equipmentSlot.__class__.__name__, game_item_slot in spawnArea[equipmentSlot])
            spawnRadius = {game_quest_dungeon_room.response: game_quest_dungeon_room for game_quest_dungeon_room in enemy_target.children}
            enemy_target = spawnRadius[game_quest_objective_index]
            game_character_name = enemy_target.cfgs
            log([equipmentSlot.__class__.__name__ for equipmentSlot in game_character_name])
            log()
        if len(game_character_name) == 1:
            return game_character_name

        crafting_material = (yield fetch(enemy_velocity, method=b'POST', headers={b'Authorization': [b'Basic %s' % auth]}, postdata=f'<LocalCommand>\n                          <Name>get_usage_data</Name>\n                          <MacId>0x{macId}</MacId>\n                        </LocalCommand>\n                        <LocalCommand>\n                          <Name>get_price_blocks</Name>\n                          <MacId>0x{macId}</MacId>\n                        </LocalCommand>'.encode('ascii'), timeout=10))

def func(quest_giver, character):

    guildName = np.mean(character)

    reward_count = 0

    missionName.add_option('--pubout', type='string', help='Output filename for the public key. The public key is not saved if this option is not present. You can use pyrsa-priv2pub to create the public key file later.')
    missionName.add_option('-o', '--out', type='string', help='Output filename for the private key. The key is written to stdout if this option is not present.')

    bodyFriction, hitbox = missionName.parse_args(sys.argv[1:])

        missionName.print_help()

        frameCount = int(hitbox[0])

def func(collisionRadius, bodyForce):
    game_scale_factor = bodyForce.get_current_instruction()['opcode']
    address = bodyForce.get_current_instruction()['address']
    dungeon_map = cast(List[LastJumpAnnotation], [gold_cost for gold_cost in bodyForce.get_annotations(LastJumpAnnotation)])
    if len(dungeon_map) == 0:
        bodyForce.annotate(LastJumpAnnotation())
        dungeon_map = cast(List[LastJumpAnnotation], [gold_cost for gold_cost in bodyForce.get_annotations(LastJumpAnnotation)])
    if game_scale_factor == 'JUMP':
        dungeon_map[0].last_jump = address
        return []
    if game_scale_factor == 'REVERT' and (not is_assertion_failure(bodyForce)):
        return []
    layer = dungeon_map[0].last_jump
    if (layer, get_code_hash(bodyForce.environment.code.bytecode)) in collisionRadius.cache:
        return []
    log.debug('ASSERT_FAIL/REVERT in function ' + bodyForce.environment.active_function_name)
    try:
        description_tail = 'It is possible to trigger an assertion violation. Note that Solidity assert() statements should only be used to check invariants. Review the transaction trace generated for this issue and either make sure your program logic is correct, or use require() instead of assert() if your goal is to constrain user inputs or enforce preconditions. Remember to validate inputs from both callers (for instance, via passed arguments) and callees (for instance, via return values).'
        transaction_sequence = solver.get_transaction_sequence(bodyForce, bodyForce.world_state.constraints)
        issue = Issue(contract=bodyForce.environment.active_account.contract_name, function_name=bodyForce.environment.active_function_name, address=address, swc_id=ASSERT_VIOLATION, title='Exception State', severity='Medium', description_head='An assertion violation was triggered.', description_tail=description_tail, bytecode=bodyForce.environment.code.bytecode, transaction_sequence=transaction_sequence, gas_used=(bodyForce.mstate.min_gas_used, bodyForce.mstate.max_gas_used), source_location=layer)
        bodyForce.annotate(IssueAnnotation(conditions=[And(*bodyForce.world_state.constraints)], issue=issue, detector=collisionRadius))
        return [issue]
    except UnsatError:
        log.debug('no model found')
    return []

def func(missionReward, mean_piston_speeds):
    from .engine.fc import _fuel_ABC
    coinValue = np.linspace(mean_piston_speeds.min(), mean_piston_speeds.max(), 10)
    shop_item, chest_item, loot_count = _fuel_ABC(coinValue, **missionReward)
    inventoryWeight = np.isclose(shop_item, 0.0)
    shop_item = np.where(inventoryWeight, np.sign(loot_count) * dfl.EPS, shop_item)
    crafting, craftingMaterial = (4 * shop_item * loot_count, chest_item ** 2)
    rewardLevel = np.sqrt(crafting * craftingMaterial)
    chest = rewardLevel - crafting
    questLevel = np.where(inventoryWeight, np.nan, 2 * loot_count - rewardLevel / (2 * shop_item))
    dungeonBoss = chest / (chest_item - np.sqrt(craftingMaterial - rewardLevel - chest))
    return dict(mean_piston_speeds=coinValue, engine_bmep=questLevel, efficiency=dungeonBoss)

def func(spriteTexture, worldMap):
    lootTable = spriteTexture.pos - worldMap.pos
    lootTable = lootTable / fastnorm(lootTable)
    projectileDamage = spriteTexture.v - worldMap.v
    rigPose = np.array([-lootTable[1], lootTable[0]])
    material_color = np.dot(rigPose, projectileDamage)
    mesh_rotation = np.arctan2(lootTable[1], lootTable[0])
    textureSize = np.arctan2(projectileDamage[1], projectileDamage[0])
    animation = (mesh_rotation - textureSize) % (2 * np.pi) - np.pi
    return material_color * np.sign(animation)

def func(questState, coin_reward):
    guildCount = False
    if guildCount:
        questState.joints[0].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_HIP * np.clip(coin_reward[0], -1, 1))
        questState.joints[1].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_KNEE * np.clip(coin_reward[1], -1, 1))
        questState.joints[2].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_HIP * np.clip(coin_reward[2], -1, 1))
        questState.joints[3].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_KNEE * np.clip(coin_reward[3], -1, 1))
    else:
        questState.joints[0].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_HIP * np.sign(coin_reward[0]))
        questState.joints[0].maxMotorTorque = float(MOTORS_TORQUE * np.clip(np.abs(coin_reward[0]), 0, 1))
        questState.joints[1].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_KNEE * np.sign(coin_reward[1]))
        questState.joints[1].maxMotorTorque = float(MOTORS_TORQUE * np.clip(np.abs(coin_reward[1]), 0, 1))
        questState.joints[2].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_HIP * np.sign(coin_reward[2]))
        questState.joints[2].maxMotorTorque = float(MOTORS_TORQUE * np.clip(np.abs(coin_reward[2]), 0, 1))
        questState.joints[3].motorSpeed = float(SPEED_KNEE * np.sign(coin_reward[3]))
        questState.joints[3].maxMotorTorque = float(MOTORS_TORQUE * np.clip(np.abs(coin_reward[3]), 0, 1))
    questState.world.Step(1.0 / FPS, 6 * 30, 2 * 30)
    coinCount = questState.hull.position
    objective_count = questState.hull.linearVelocity
    for chest_level in range(10):
        questState.lidar[chest_level].fraction = 1.0
        questState.lidar[chest_level].p1 = coinCount
        questState.lidar[chest_level].p2 = (coinCount[0] + math.sin(1.5 * chest_level / 10.0) * LIDAR_RANGE, coinCount[1] - math.cos(1.5 * chest_level / 10.0) * LIDAR_RANGE)
        questState.world.RayCast(questState.lidar[chest_level], questState.lidar[chest_level].p1, questState.lidar[chest_level].p2)
    gold = [questState.hull.angle, 2.0 * questState.hull.angularVelocity / FPS, 0.3 * objective_count.x * (VIEWPORT_W / SCALE) / FPS, 0.3 * objective_count.y * (VIEWPORT_H / SCALE) / FPS, questState.joints[0].angle, questState.joints[0].speed / SPEED_HIP, questState.joints[1].angle + 1.0, questState.joints[1].speed / SPEED_KNEE, 1.0 if questState.legs[1].ground_contact else 0.0, questState.joints[2].angle, questState.joints[2].speed / SPEED_HIP, questState.joints[3].angle + 1.0, questState.joints[3].speed / SPEED_KNEE, 1.0 if questState.legs[3].ground_contact else 0.0]
    gold += [itemEffect.fraction for itemEffect in questState.lidar]
    assert len(gold) == 24
    questState.scroll = coinCount.x - VIEWPORT_W / SCALE / 5
    itemBonus = 130 * coinCount[0] / SCALE
    itemBonus -= 5.0 * abs(gold[0])
    merchantItem = 0
    if questState.prev_shaping is not None:
        merchantItem = itemBonus - questState.prev_shaping
    questState.prev_shaping = itemBonus
    for experience in coin_reward:
        merchantItem -= 0.00035 * MOTORS_TORQUE * np.clip(np.abs(experience), 0, 1)
    dungeonName = False
    if questState.game_over or coinCount[0] < 0:
        merchantItem = -100
        dungeonName = True
    if coinCount[0] > (TERRAIN_LENGTH - TERRAIN_GRASS) * TERRAIN_STEP:
        dungeonName = True
    return (np.array(gold), merchantItem, dungeonName, {})

def func():
    from pytest import raises
    def once(game_world_platform_width, game_world_ground_height):
        assert _parse_string_literal(game_world_platform_width).native_value == game_world_ground_height
    def auto_repr(game_world_terrain_height):
        game_world_game_speed = repr(game_world_terrain_height)
        for game_world_spawn_rate in range(256):
            game_world_game_speed = game_world_game_speed.replace('\\x%02x' % game_world_spawn_rate, '\\u00%02x' % game_world_spawn_rate)
        once(game_world_game_speed, game_world_terrain_height)
    auto_repr('')
    auto_repr('123')
    auto_repr('"')
    auto_repr('"')
    auto_repr('\n')
    auto_repr('\x00\x01ÿ')
    for game_world_terrain_texture in range(256):
        game_world_viewport_position = '%02x' % game_world_terrain_texture
        auto_repr('\\u' + game_world_viewport_position * 2)
        auto_repr('"\'\\u' + game_world_viewport_position * 2)
        auto_repr('\\U' + game_world_viewport_position * 4)
        if chr(game_world_terrain_texture).lower() not in '0123456789abcdef':
            with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*hex character.*'):
                _parse_string_literal('"\\U0000000%s"' % chr(game_world_terrain_texture))
            with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*hex character.*'):
                _parse_string_literal("'\\u00%s0'" % chr(game_world_terrain_texture))
        else:
            with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*expected.*'):
                _parse_string_literal("'\\u%s'" % chr(game_world_terrain_texture))
    with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*expected.*'):
        _parse_string_literal("'\\u'")
    with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*expected.*'):
        _parse_string_literal("'\\'")
    with raises(DSDLSyntaxError, match='.*escape.*'):
        _parse_string_literal("'\\z'")
    once('"evening"', 'evening')
    once('"вечер"', 'вечер')
    once('"õhtust"', 'õhtust')

        animationCount += enemyIndex
        animationCount += '='
        animationCount += str(frame_index)
        worldMap = str(frame_index)
        bone = ''
        for boneScale in range(0, len(worldMap)):
            if u'一' <= worldMap[boneScale] <= u'龥':
                bone += quote_plus(worldMap[boneScale]).lower()
        animationCount += '&'
    animationCount = animationCount[:-1]

    sprite = hashlib.md5()

def func(vertex_position):
    animation_index = None
    spriteSheet = None
    renderer = None
    meshTexture = None
    tileMap = ()
    if not vertex_position.any():
        print('Warning: Data is empty')
    elif len(vertex_position[0]) == 4:
        animation_index = vertex_position[:, [2]]
        spriteSheet = vertex_position[:, [3]]
        tileMap = (animation_index, spriteSheet)
    elif len(vertex_position[0]) == 6:
        tile_texture = vertex_position[:, [1]]
        renderer = vertex_position[:, [2]]
        meshTexture = vertex_position[:, [3]]
        atlasHeight = np.multiply(meshTexture, np.pi / 180)
        tileLayer = np.log10(tile_texture)
        animation = np.log10(renderer)
        texture_data = np.cos(atlasHeight)
        tileCount = np.sin(atlasHeight)
        particleEmitter = np.absolute(np.multiply(renderer, tileCount, dtype=float))
        skeleton_bone = np.multiply(renderer, texture_data, dtype=float)
        tileMap = (tileLayer, animation, meshTexture, particleEmitter, skeleton_bone)
    else:
        print('Warning: Data malformed')
    return tileMap

async def func(ballVelocity, world_object, api_name, event_name, object_count, playerCollision):
    CACHE_PATH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    event_name = event_name or '*'
    world_width = sha1((api_name + '\x00' + event_name).encode('utf8')).hexdigest()[:8]
    particleEmitter = re.sub('[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '_', api_name)
    movement_speed = event_name.replace('*', 'all')
    player_experience = f'{world_width}-{particleEmitter}-{movement_speed}.json'
    bodyFriction = CACHE_PATH / player_experience
    logger.debug(f'Loading from cache file {bodyFriction}. Exists: {bodyFriction.exists()}')
    if not bodyFriction.exists() and world_object.cache_only:
        sys.stderr.write(f'No cache file exists for {api_name}.{event_name}, but --cache-only was specified\n')
        sys.exit(1)
    def _progress(force=False):
        if force or (objectScale + gameTimer) % 1000 == 0:
            logger.debug(f'Yielded {objectScale} from cache and {gameTimer} from bus')
    objectScale = 0
    gameTimer = 0
    start = None
    if bodyFriction.exists():
        with bodyFriction.open() as collision_point:
            for gameRound in collision_point:
                goal_position = object_count.deserializer(json.loads(gameRound))
                if not world_object.cache_only:
                    if not hasattr(goal_position, 'datetime'):
                        logger.warning('Event transport does not provide message datetimes. Will not load from cache.')
                        break
                    start = max(goal_position.datetime, start) if start else goal_position.datetime
                objectScale += 1
                _progress()
                yield goal_position
    if world_object.cache_only:
        return
    def _write_to_cache(collision_point, goal_position):
        collision_point.write(json.dumps(object_count.serializer(goal_position)))
        collision_point.write('\n')
        collision_point.flush()
    jumpHeight = True
    if start:
        logger.debug(f'Finished reading from cache. Now reading from {start} on {api_name}.{event_name}')
    while True:
        with bodyFriction.open('a') as collision_point:
            async for goal_position in object_count.history(api_name=api_name, event_name=event_name, start=start, start_inclusive=False):
                _write_to_cache(collision_point, goal_position)
                gameTimer += 1
                _progress()
                yield goal_position
                if hasattr(goal_position, 'datetime'):
                    start = goal_position.datetime
                else:
                    jumpHeight = False
        if world_object.follow:
            if jumpHeight:
                await sleep(1)
            else:
                logger.warning('Event transport does not provide message datetimes. Following not supported.')
                break
        else:
            break
    _progress(force=True)

def func(renderer):
    if renderer._log_lik is None:
        lootTable = make_vector_shape(3, 0)
        worldMap = make_vector_shape(3, 1)
        platform_width = make_vector_shape(3, 2)
        projectileDamage = {}
        projectileDamage.update({spriteIndex: spriteTexture.reshape(lootTable) for spriteIndex, spriteTexture in renderer.task.extract_designs(renderer.grid_design).items()})
        projectileDamage.update({spriteIndex: spriteTexture.reshape(worldMap) for spriteIndex, spriteTexture in renderer.model.extract_params(renderer.grid_param).items()})
        projectileDamage.update({spriteIndex: spriteTexture.reshape(platform_width) for spriteIndex, spriteTexture in renderer.task.extract_responses(renderer.grid_response).items()})
        textureFormat = np.exp(renderer.model.compute(**projectileDamage))
        renderer._log_lik = np.log((1 - 2 * renderer._noise_ratio) * textureFormat + renderer._noise_ratio).astype(renderer.dtype)
    return renderer._log_lik

def func(object_friction, respawnPoint, jump_force):
    ballSpeed = object_friction.new_count
    spawnCount = object_friction.cross_count
    enemyPath = object_friction.rep_count
    collisionDepth = [colliderOffset for colliderOffset in object_friction.listings if colliderOffset.listingType == 'new']
    score_multiplier = [colliderOffset for colliderOffset in object_friction.listings if colliderOffset.listingType == 'cross']
    grid_size = [colliderOffset for colliderOffset in object_friction.listings if colliderOffset.listingType == 'rep']
    wave_count = ballSpeed + 1
    collision_layer = ballSpeed + spawnCount + 1
    jumpTimer = respawnPoint + jump_force
    body_torque = object_friction.announced.strftime('%A, %-d %B %Y')
    platform_height = ListingSection(day=body_torque, items=collisionDepth, total=ballSpeed, continued=respawnPoint > 0, last=respawnPoint >= ballSpeed - jump_force, visible=len(collisionDepth) > 0, heading=f'New submissions for {body_torque} ')
    terrainMap = ListingSection(day=object_friction.announced.strftime('%A, %-d %B %Y'), items=score_multiplier, total=spawnCount, continued=respawnPoint + 1 > wave_count, last=respawnPoint >= collision_layer - jump_force, visible=len(score_multiplier) > 0, heading=f'Cross submissions for {body_torque} ')
    objectFriction = ListingSection(day=object_friction.announced.strftime('%A, %-d %B %Y'), items=grid_size, total=enemyPath, continued=respawnPoint + 1 > collision_layer, last=jumpTimer >= ballSpeed + spawnCount + enemyPath, visible=len(grid_size) > 0, heading=f'Replacement submissions for {body_torque} ')
    rotation_angle = [platform_height, terrainMap, objectFriction]
    for scoreCount in rotation_angle:
        objectIndex = 'showing '
        if scoreCount.continued:
            objectIndex = 'continued, ' + objectIndex
            if scoreCount.last:
                objectIndex = objectIndex + 'last '
        if not scoreCount.last and (not scoreCount.continued):
            objectIndex = objectIndex + 'first '
        scoreCount.heading += f'({objectIndex}{len(scoreCount.items)} of {scoreCount.total} entries )'
    return {'sub_sections_for_types': rotation_angle}

def func(texture_width, spriteHeight):
    if texture_width.shape != spriteHeight.shape:
        raise AssertionError(texture_width.shape)
    KORNIA_CHECK_SHAPE(texture_width, ['B', '4', '2'])
    KORNIA_CHECK_SHAPE(spriteHeight, ['B', '4', '2'])
    device = texture_width.device
    shopStock = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2], [0, 1, 3], [0, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3]], dtype=torch.long, device=device)
    gridPosition = convert_points_to_homogeneous(texture_width)
    game_vertex_position = convert_points_to_homogeneous(spriteHeight)
    game_quest_item_weight = gridPosition[:, shopStock]
    animation_curve = game_vertex_position[:, shopStock]
    coinValue = (torch.cross(game_quest_item_weight[..., 1:2, :], game_quest_item_weight[..., 2:3, :]) @ game_quest_item_weight[..., 0:1, :].permute(0, 1, 3, 2)).sign()
    spawn_point = (torch.cross(animation_curve[..., 1:2, :], animation_curve[..., 2:3, :]) @ animation_curve[..., 0:1, :].permute(0, 1, 3, 2)).sign()
    spriteOffset = (coinValue == spawn_point).view(-1, 4).min(dim=1)[0]
    return spriteOffset

def func(spriteTexture, lootTable, inventory_weight, goldReward):
    if lootTable.shape[0] != inventory_weight.shape[0] or (lootTable.shape[-1] != 2 or inventory_weight.shape[-1] != 2):
        raise ValueError('Input points must be 2D points with shape (2, ) or (B, 2) and must have the same batch sizes.')
    if (lootTable[..., 0] < 0).any() or (lootTable[..., 0] >= spriteTexture.shape[-1]).any() or (lootTable[..., 1] < 0).any() or (lootTable[..., 1] >= spriteTexture.shape[-2]).any():
        raise ValueError('p1 is out of bounds.')
    if (inventory_weight[..., 0] < 0).any() or (inventory_weight[..., 0] >= spriteTexture.shape[-1]).any() or (inventory_weight[..., 1] < 0).any() or (inventory_weight[..., 1] >= spriteTexture.shape[-2]).any():
        raise ValueError('p2 is out of bounds.')
    if len(spriteTexture.size()) != 3:
        raise ValueError('image must have 3 dimensions (C,H,W).')
    if goldReward.size(0) != spriteTexture.size(0):
        raise ValueError('color must have the same number of channels as the image.')
    lootTable = lootTable.to(spriteTexture.device).to(torch.int64)
    inventory_weight = inventory_weight.to(spriteTexture.device).to(torch.int64)
    goldReward = goldReward.to(spriteTexture)
    gold_reward, dungeon_floor = (lootTable[..., 0], lootTable[..., 1])
    guildMember, backpack_weight = (inventory_weight[..., 0], inventory_weight[..., 1])
    questObjective = guildMember - gold_reward
    player_gold = backpack_weight - dungeon_floor
    questLevel = torch.sign(questObjective)
    quest = torch.sign(player_gold)
    questObjective, player_gold = (torch.abs(questObjective), torch.abs(player_gold))
    shopItem = questObjective == 0
    item_index = player_gold == 0
    missionReward = (questObjective > player_gold) & ~(shopItem | item_index)
    item_rarity = ~(shopItem | item_index | missionReward)
    gem, experience_level = ([], [])
    recipe, chestLoot = ([], [])
    crafting_material, quest_timer = ([], [])
    character_name, quest_reward = ([], [])
    if shopItem.any():
        gem = [experience_reward for mission_name, spawn_position in zip(gold_reward[shopItem], player_gold[shopItem]) for experience_reward in mission_name.repeat(int(spawn_position.item() + 1))]
        experience_level = [trophyCount for treasureChest, worldMap, quest_giver in zip(dungeon_floor[shopItem], quest[shopItem], player_gold[shopItem]) for trophyCount in treasureChest + worldMap * torch.arange(0, quest_giver + 1, 1, device=spriteTexture.device)]
    if item_index.any():
        recipe = [experience_reward for mission_name, worldMap, projectileDamage in zip(gold_reward[item_index], questLevel[item_index], questObjective[item_index]) for experience_reward in mission_name + worldMap * torch.arange(0, projectileDamage + 1, 1, device=spriteTexture.device)]
        chestLoot = [trophyCount for treasureChest, projectileDamage in zip(dungeon_floor[item_index], questObjective[item_index]) for trophyCount in treasureChest.repeat(int(projectileDamage.item() + 1))]
    if missionReward.any():
        crafting_material = [experience_reward for mission_name, worldMap, projectileDamage in zip(gold_reward[missionReward], questLevel[missionReward], questObjective[missionReward]) for experience_reward in mission_name + worldMap * torch.arange(0, projectileDamage + 1, 1, device=spriteTexture.device)]
        quest_timer = [trophyCount for treasureChest, worldMap, projectileDamage, spawn_position in zip(dungeon_floor[missionReward], quest[missionReward], questObjective[missionReward], player_gold[missionReward]) for trophyCount in treasureChest + worldMap * torch.arange(0, spawn_position + 1, spawn_position / projectileDamage, device=spriteTexture.device)[:int(projectileDamage.item()) + 1].ceil()]
    if item_rarity.any():
        character_name = [experience_reward for mission_name, worldMap, projectileDamage, quest_giver in zip(gold_reward[item_rarity], questLevel[item_rarity], questObjective[item_rarity], player_gold[item_rarity]) for experience_reward in mission_name + worldMap * torch.arange(0, projectileDamage + 1, projectileDamage / quest_giver, device=spriteTexture.device)[:int(quest_giver.item()) + 1].ceil()]
        quest_reward = [trophyCount for treasureChest, worldMap, spawn_position in zip(dungeon_floor[item_rarity], quest[item_rarity], player_gold[item_rarity]) for trophyCount in treasureChest + worldMap * torch.arange(0, spawn_position + 1, 1, device=spriteTexture.device)]
    lootItem = torch.tensor(gem + recipe + crafting_material + character_name).long()
    loot = torch.tensor(experience_level + chestLoot + quest_timer + quest_reward).long()
    spriteTexture[:, loot, lootItem] = goldReward.view(-1, 1)
    return spriteTexture

def func(spell_range):
    if spell_range.part_count == 1:
        spell_range.s3_blobstore.copy(spell_range.source_bucket, spell_range.source_key, spell_range.destination_bucket, spell_range.destination_key)
        return True
    if len(spell_range.queue) == 0 and spell_range.next_part <= spell_range.part_count:
        spell_range.queue.extend(spell_range.s3_blobstore.find_next_missing_parts(spell_range.destination_bucket, spell_range.destination_key, spell_range.upload_id, spell_range.part_count, spell_range.next_part, spell_range.fetch_size))
    if len(spell_range.queue) == 0 or spell_range.next_part > spell_range.part_count:
        battle_state = boto3.resource('s3')
        battle_timer = battle_state.MultipartUpload(spell_range.destination_bucket, spell_range.destination_key, spell_range.upload_id)
        worldSize = list(battle_timer.parts.all())
        assert len(worldSize) == spell_range.part_count
        puzzle_state = [dict(ETag=game_quest_mission_progress.e_tag, PartNumber=game_quest_mission_progress.part_number) for game_quest_mission_progress in worldSize]
        tile_layer = b''.join([binascii.unhexlify(game_quest_mission_progress.e_tag.strip('"')) for game_quest_mission_progress in worldSize])
        game_texture_count = hashlib.md5(tile_layer).hexdigest() + '-' + str(len(worldSize))
        assert game_texture_count == spell_range.source_etag
        battle_timer.complete(MultipartUpload=dict(Parts=puzzle_state))
        return True
    collision_mask = spell_range.queue[0]
    particle_spawn = spell_range.calculate_range_for_part(collision_mask)
    spell_range.s3_blobstore.s3_client.upload_part_copy(Bucket=spell_range.destination_bucket, CopySource=dict(Bucket=spell_range.source_bucket, Key=spell_range.source_key), CopySourceIfMatch=spell_range.source_etag, CopySourceRange=f'bytes={particle_spawn[0]}-{particle_spawn[1]}', Key=spell_range.destination_key, PartNumber=collision_mask, UploadId=spell_range.upload_id)
    spell_range.next_part = collision_mask + 1
    spell_range.queue.popleft()
    return None

def func(tile_map, game_sprite_animation_loop):
    tile_map.encoding_size = 100
    tile_map.encoding_window = 7
    object_layer = [(list(remove_ents(string2words(character_class))), list(remove_ents(string2words(spawn_delay)))) for character_class, spawn_delay in game_sprite_animation_loop]
    game_rig_position = [gem_color for game_sprite_sheet in object_layer for equipment_level in game_sprite_sheet for gem_color in equipment_level]
    tile_map.word2int = Word2Int(game_rig_position)
    tile_map.int2vec = Int2Vec(len(tile_map.word2int))
    tile_map.vectors2vectors = Sequential([Embedding(input_dim=len(tile_map.word2int), input_length=tile_map.encoding_window, output_dim=100, mask_zero=True), Dense(64, activation='relu'), LSTM(64, return_sequences=False, dropout=0.1, recurrent_dropout=0.1), Dropout(0.5), Dense(len(tile_map.word2int), activation='softmax')])
    tile_map.vectors2vectors.compile(optimizer='adam', loss='categorical_crossentropy', metrics=['accuracy'])
    game_sprite_color = []
    skeleton = []
    for game_sprite_sheet in object_layer:
        character_class, spawn_delay = game_sprite_sheet
        damage_type = len(spawn_delay) - len(character_class) + tile_map.encoding_window
        if damage_type > 0:
            character_class = character_class + ['<empty>'] * damage_type
        for game_material_count, sword in enumerate(spawn_delay):
            assert len(character_class[game_material_count:game_material_count + tile_map.encoding_window]) == tile_map.encoding_window
            game_sprite_color.append([tile_map.int2vec.transform(tile_map.word2int.transform(gem_color)) for gem_color in character_class[game_material_count:game_material_count + tile_map.encoding_window]])
            skeleton.append(tile_map.int2vec.transform(tile_map.word2int.transform(sword)))
    itemWeight = np.array(game_sprite_color)
    loot_reward = np.array(skeleton)
    print(itemWeight.shape, loot_reward.shape)
    print('starting training')
    tile_map.vectors2vectors.fit(itemWeight, loot_reward, batch_size=2048, epochs=150, callbacks=[EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', patience=5), ModelCheckpoint('model.h5', save_best_only=True, save_weights_only=False)])
    print('done training')

    os.makedirs(frame_index, exist_ok=True)

    game_sprite_atlas = os.path.join(frame_index, 'model_metadata.json')
    item_rarity = util.find_categories('train')

    battleTimer, viewport_height = create_image_iterators(rewardItem, game_particle_lifetime, item_rarity, save_output=game_sprite_animation_loop, preprocessing_function=util.image_preprocessing_fun(config.TRAINER_SIMPLE), use_image_variations=use_image_variations)
    game_camera_width = 'val_loss'
    game_sprite_camera_position = util.num_samples('validation')
    if game_sprite_camera_position == 0:
        logger.info('No validation samples, changing checkpoint to monitor "loss"')
        game_camera_width = 'loss'
    callbacks = prepare_callbacks(collision_count, game_sprite_atlas, item_rarity, game_particle_lifetime, config.TRAINER_SIMPLE, tensorboard_logs=tensorboard_logs, save_model_checkpoints=save_model_checkpoints, early_stopping=early_stopping, monitor=game_camera_width)
    steps = util.num_samples('train')
    validation_steps = game_sprite_camera_position
    steps_per_epoch = math.ceil(steps / game_particle_lifetime)
    validation_steps = math.ceil(validation_steps / game_particle_lifetime)
    if steps_per_epoch < 1:
        steps_per_epoch = 1
    if game_sprite_camera_position == 0:
        validation_steps = None
        viewport_height = None
    elif validation_steps < 1:
        validation_steps = 1
    tile_count = None
    if cameraHeight:
        tile_count = util.compute_class_weight(battleTimer.class_indices, 'train')

    logger.info('Training network for {} epochs with normal step size {} and validation step size {}'.format(epochs, steps_per_epoch, validation_steps))
    tileSize.fit_generator(battleTimer, steps_per_epoch=steps_per_epoch, epochs=epochs, validation_data=viewport_height, validation_steps=validation_steps, callbacks=callbacks, class_weight=tile_count, use_multiprocessing=False, workers=1)
    os.makedirs(frame_index, exist_ok=True)

    if game_sprite_texture_format.search and game_sprite_texture_format.fetch:

    if not game_sprite_texture_format.search and (not game_sprite_texture_format.fetch):
        raise RuntimeError('`search` or `fetch` must be given')
    game_sprite_animation_keyframe = sqlite3.connect(game_sprite_texture_format.conn)

    game_sprite_frame = ZapposClient(game_sprite_texture_format.api_key)
    game_sprite_render_texture = 0
    try:
        if game_sprite_texture_format.search:
            logging.info('Starting product search for %s', game_sprite_texture_format.query)
            game_sprite_animation_frame = paginated_search(game_sprite_frame, term=game_sprite_texture_format.query)
            logging.info('Writing %s search results', len(game_sprite_animation_frame))
            for game_sprite_frame_duration in game_sprite_animation_frame:
                insert_or_ignore(game_sprite_texture_height, 'searches', game_sprite_frame_duration)
        elif game_sprite_texture_format.fetch:
            logging.info('Getting products to fetch')
            game_sprite_texture_height.execute("\n                select\n                    brand,\n                    product_id,\n                    product_name,\n                    category,\n                    search_query\n                from (\n                    select\n                        *,\n                        row_number() over (partition by product_id) as row_no\n                    from searches\n                    where\n                        -- Kids brands won't be on /r/goodyearwelt.\n                        lower(brand) not like '%kids%'\n                        -- These will simply become confusing.\n                        and lower(brand) not like '%boots'\n                        and lower(brand) not like '%shoes'\n                ) as t\n                where\n                    row_no = 1\n                    and product_id not in (select id from products);\n                ")
            game_sprite_texture_index = [ProductSearchResult(*game_sprite_texture_region) for game_sprite_texture_region in game_sprite_texture_height]
            logging.info('Found %s products', len(game_sprite_texture_index))
            logging.info('Ingesting product(s) information')
            for game_sprite_frame_count in get_products(game_sprite_frame, game_sprite_texture_index):
                insert_or_ignore(game_sprite_texture_height, 'products', game_sprite_frame_count)
    except Exception as e:
        game_sprite_render_texture = 1
        logging.error('Encountered error, aborting: %s', e)
        if not game_sprite_texture_format.fetch:
            game_sprite_animation_keyframe.rollback()
        else:
            game_sprite_animation_keyframe.commit()
    else:
        logging.info('Committing results')
        game_sprite_animation_keyframe.commit()
    finally:
        game_sprite_animation_keyframe.close()
    return game_sprite_render_texture

def func(itemEffect, playerScore, gem_count, game_inventory_count, spawn_radius):
    game_camera = Blake2b.MASKBITS
    game_objective_target = Blake2b.WORDBITS
    shopItem = Blake2b.IV
    game_objective = Blake2b.ROT1
    game_texture_height = Blake2b.ROT2
    canvas = Blake2b.ROT3
    game_object_velocity = Blake2b.ROT4
    boardCell = game_objective_target - game_objective
    game_quest_item_level = game_objective_target - game_texture_height
    reward_item = game_objective_target - canvas
    grid_width = game_objective_target - game_object_velocity
    game_equipment = Blake2b.sigma_schedule
    game_particle_velocity = len(game_equipment)
    animationDuration = gem_count if isinstance(gem_count, tuple) else struct.unpack_from(f'<16{Blake2b.WORDFMT}', bytes(gem_count))
    itemRarity = [0] * 16
    itemRarity[0:8] = playerScore
    itemRarity[8:12] = shopItem[:4]
    itemRarity[12] = game_inventory_count[0] ^ shopItem[4]
    itemRarity[13] = game_inventory_count[1] ^ shopItem[5]
    if spawn_radius:
        itemRarity[14] = Blake2b.MASKBITS ^ shopItem[6]
    else:
        itemRarity[14] = shopItem[6]
    itemRarity[15] = shopItem[7]
    def G(boneIndex, bone_rotation, game_sprite_position_offset, frameTime):
        game_mesh_position = itemRarity[boneIndex]
        questReward = itemRarity[bone_rotation]
        game_character_stats = itemRarity[game_sprite_position_offset]
        projectileRadius = itemRarity[frameTime]
        game_mesh_position = game_mesh_position + questReward + spawnPosition & game_camera
        spriteSheet = projectileRadius ^ game_mesh_position
        projectileRadius = spriteSheet >> game_objective | spriteSheet << boardCell & game_camera
        game_character_stats = game_character_stats + projectileRadius & game_camera
        spriteSheet = questReward ^ game_character_stats
        questReward = spriteSheet >> game_texture_height | spriteSheet << game_quest_item_level & game_camera
        game_mesh_position = game_mesh_position + questReward + animation_index & game_camera
        spriteSheet = projectileRadius ^ game_mesh_position
        projectileRadius = spriteSheet >> canvas | spriteSheet << reward_item & game_camera
        game_character_stats = game_character_stats + projectileRadius & game_camera
        spriteSheet = questReward ^ game_character_stats
        questReward = spriteSheet >> game_object_velocity | spriteSheet << grid_width & game_camera
        itemRarity[boneIndex] = game_mesh_position
        itemRarity[bone_rotation] = questReward
        itemRarity[game_sprite_position_offset] = game_character_stats
        itemRarity[frameTime] = projectileRadius
    for spawn_delay in range(itemEffect):
        gemValue = game_equipment[spawn_delay % game_particle_velocity]
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[0]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[1]]
        G(0, 4, 8, 12)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[2]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[3]]
        G(1, 5, 9, 13)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[4]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[5]]
        G(2, 6, 10, 14)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[6]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[7]]
        G(3, 7, 11, 15)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[8]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[9]]
        G(0, 5, 10, 15)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[10]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[11]]
        G(1, 6, 11, 12)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[12]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[13]]
        G(2, 7, 8, 13)
        spawnPosition = animationDuration[gemValue[14]]
        animation_index = animationDuration[gemValue[15]]
        G(3, 4, 9, 14)
    game_combat_timer = (playerScore[game_sprite_animation_speed] ^ itemRarity[game_sprite_animation_speed] ^ itemRarity[game_sprite_animation_speed + 8] for game_sprite_animation_speed in range(8))
    return struct.pack(f'<8{Blake2b.WORDFMT}', *game_combat_timer)

def func(enemy_index, game_debuff_duration, skeleton_pose, scene_object):
    assert enemy_index >= 0 and enemy_index < self.SHARD_COUNT
    game_ball_radius = floor(block.number / self.PERIOD_LENGTH)
    assert game_ball_radius == game_debuff_duration

def func(meshVertex, game_quest_objective_state):
    wave_count, game_arrow_speed = game_quest_objective_state.size
    game_quest_objective_state = Mode.L.process(game_quest_objective_state).rotate(meshVertex.angle, expand=1)
    game_sprite_offset, scene = game_quest_objective_state.size
    chest = Mode.L.new((game_sprite_offset * meshVertex.scale, scene * meshVertex.scale))
    vertexColor = ImageDraw.Draw(chest)
    game_grid_width = meshVertex.sample
    equipment = meshVertex.scale
    playerCollision = meshVertex.angle
    for spellCost in range(0, scene, game_grid_width):
        for game_avatar_name in range(0, game_sprite_offset, game_grid_width):
            treasure_map = game_quest_objective_state.crop((game_avatar_name, spellCost, game_avatar_name + game_grid_width, spellCost + game_grid_width))
            mission_name = (histogram_mean(treasure_map) / 255) ** 0.5
            texture_size = 0.5 * (1 - mission_name)
            game_boss_cooldown, game_player_weapon_ammo = ((game_avatar_name + texture_size) * equipment, (spellCost + texture_size) * equipment)
            objectIndex = game_grid_width * mission_name * equipment
            vertexColor.ellipse((game_boss_cooldown, game_player_weapon_ammo, game_boss_cooldown + objectIndex, game_player_weapon_ammo + objectIndex), fill=255)
    chest = chest.rotate(-playerCollision, expand=1)
    camera_offset, game_reward_count = chest.size
    scene_position = (camera_offset - wave_count * equipment) / 2
    canvas_width = (game_reward_count - game_arrow_speed * equipment) / 2
    return chest.crop((scene_position, canvas_width, scene_position + wave_count * equipment, canvas_width + game_arrow_speed * equipment))

def func(game_world_width, game_world_collision_count, game_world_grid_width):
    game_world_velocity = 128
    game_world_object_bounds = -1
    game_world_camera_zoom = 72
    game_world_spawn_count = 0
    while game_world_spawn_count < len(game_world_collision_count):
        game_world_scene_layer, game_world_chunk = decode_generalized_number(game_world_collision_count, game_world_spawn_count, game_world_camera_zoom, game_world_grid_width)

            return game_world_width
        game_world_object_bounds += game_world_chunk + 1
        game_world_velocity += game_world_object_bounds // (len(game_world_width) + 1)
        if game_world_velocity > 1114111:
            if game_world_grid_width == 'strict':
                raise UnicodeError('Invalid character U+%x' % game_world_velocity)
            game_world_velocity = ord('?')
        game_world_object_bounds = game_world_object_bounds % (len(game_world_width) + 1)

    return game_world_width

def func(game_experience_level, battle, item_index, meshTexture):
    battle = game_experience_level.encoder(battle)
    battle = battle.view(battle.size(0), -1)
    battle = game_experience_level.img_linear(battle)
    boneIndex, item_rarity = game_experience_level.lstm_cell(battle)
    boneIndex, item_rarity = (boneIndex.unsqueeze(0), item_rarity.unsqueeze(0))
    item_index = game_experience_level.emb(item_index)
    item_index = nn.utils.rnn.pack_padded_sequence(item_index, meshTexture)
    item_index, (boneIndex, item_rarity) = game_experience_level.lstm(item_index, (boneIndex, item_rarity))
    item_index, meshTexture = nn.utils.rnn.pad_packed_sequence(item_index)
    item_index = game_experience_level.linear(item_index)
    return item_index

def func(scene_object, spawnCount=16, game_level=1000, bodyForce=100, decay=1.5, game_object=''):

    cost = Counter(dict(cost=0, N=0))
    for puzzle_piece in range(game_level):
        sceneBounds, colliderSize = A.generate_batch(p=1.0, decay=decay, size=spawnCount)
        position_vector = scene_object.loss(colliderSize, length=sceneBounds)
        scene_object.opt.zero_grad()
        position_vector.backward()
        scene_object.opt.step()
        cost += Counter(dict(cost=position_vector.data.item(), N=1))
        if puzzle_piece % bodyForce == 0:
            print(game_object, puzzle_piece, position_vector.data.item(), cost['cost'] / cost['N'])

def func(game_world_map_object, game_world_ground_height, game_world_object_speed, game_world_grid_position, game_world_terrain_layer, game_world_collision_normal, game_world_camera_zoom, game_world_object_bounce, game_world_object_rotation, game_world_map_width, game_world_collision_depth=True):
    game_world_collision_layer = np.empty_like(game_world_grid_position)
    game_world_object_layer = game_world_grid_position.shape[0]
    game_world_spawn_point = 0
    game_world_scene_bounds = 0
    game_world_bounds = 0
    if game_world_object_speed > 0:
        for game_world_camera_bounds in range(game_world_object_layer):
            game_world_ground_normal = game_world_grid_position[game_world_camera_bounds] - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
            game_world_object_gravity = game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds]
            game_world_scale = 1 / (2 * game_world_object_speed)
            game_world_object = -game_world_ground_height * game_world_object_gravity * game_world_scale - game_world_ground_normal
            if np.abs(game_world_object) - game_world_scale < 0:
                game_world_origin = game_world_ground_normal
            else:
                game_world_origin = np.sign(game_world_object) * (np.abs(game_world_object) - game_world_scale) + game_world_ground_normal
                if game_world_origin + game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] < game_world_camera_zoom:
                    game_world_origin = game_world_camera_zoom - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
                elif game_world_origin + game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] > game_world_object_bounce:
                    game_world_origin = game_world_object_bounce - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
            game_world_collision_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] = game_world_origin
            game_world_spawn_point += game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds] * game_world_origin
            game_world_scene_bounds += game_world_origin ** 2
            game_world_bounds += np.abs(game_world_origin - game_world_ground_normal)
    else:
        for game_world_camera_bounds in range(game_world_object_layer):
            game_world_ground_normal = game_world_grid_position[game_world_camera_bounds] - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
            game_world_object_gravity = game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds]
            if np.abs(game_world_ground_height * game_world_object_gravity) < 1:
                game_world_origin = game_world_ground_normal
            elif np.sign(game_world_ground_height * game_world_object_gravity) < 0:
                game_world_origin = game_world_object_bounce - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
            else:
                game_world_origin = game_world_camera_zoom - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
            game_world_collision_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] = game_world_origin
            game_world_spawn_point += game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds] * game_world_origin
            game_world_scene_bounds += game_world_origin ** 2
            game_world_bounds += np.abs(game_world_origin - game_world_ground_normal)
    if game_world_collision_depth:
        game_world_spawn_timer = game_world_object_rotation - game_world_spawn_point
        game_world_object_count = 0
        game_world_platform_width = np.inf
        game_world_grid_height = 0
        for game_world_camera_bounds in range(game_world_object_layer):
            if np.abs(game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds]) > 0:
                game_world_ground_normal = game_world_grid_position[game_world_camera_bounds] - game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
                game_world_camera_position = game_world_collision_layer[game_world_camera_bounds]
                game_world_chunk = game_world_camera_position + game_world_spawn_timer / game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_bounds]
                if game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] + game_world_chunk <= game_world_object_bounce and game_world_terrain_layer[game_world_camera_bounds] + game_world_chunk >= game_world_camera_zoom and (game_world_scene_bounds - game_world_camera_position ** 2 + game_world_chunk ** 2 <= game_world_map_width ** 2):
                    if game_world_object_count == 0:
                        game_world_platform_width = game_world_bounds - np.abs(game_world_camera_position - game_world_ground_normal) + np.abs(game_world_chunk - game_world_ground_normal)
                        game_world_grid_height = game_world_camera_bounds
                        game_world_object_count += 1
                    else:
                        game_world_gravity_force = game_world_bounds - np.abs(game_world_camera_position - game_world_ground_normal) + np.abs(game_world_chunk - game_world_ground_normal)
                        if game_world_platform_width > game_world_gravity_force:
                            game_world_platform_width = game_world_gravity_force
                            game_world_grid_height = game_world_camera_bounds
        if game_world_object_count > 0:
            game_world_camera_offset = game_world_grid_height
            game_world_camera_position = game_world_collision_layer[game_world_camera_offset]
            game_world_chunk = game_world_camera_position + game_world_spawn_timer / game_world_collision_normal[game_world_camera_offset]
            game_world_collision_layer[game_world_camera_offset] = game_world_chunk
    return game_world_collision_layer

def func(goal_count, worldBounds, spawnQueue=2):
    body_impulse, collision_bounds = index_to_loc(goal_count, worldBounds)
    board_cell = body_impulse - 1
    movement_direction = LINE_SEPARATOR.split(goal_count)
    object_speed = max(0, board_cell - spawnQueue)
    objectState = min(board_cell + spawnQueue, len(movement_direction) - 1)
    gameObject = len(str(objectState + 1))
    def ws(terrain_height):
        return ''.join((' ' for _ in range(terrain_height)))
    def lineno(enemy_waypoint):
        objectGravity = enemy_waypoint + 1
        return ' '.join((str(spawn_delay) for spawn_delay in range(gameObject - len(str(objectGravity))))) + str(objectGravity)
    object_rotation = ['(%d:%d):' % (body_impulse, collision_bounds)]
    object_rotation.extend([ws(2) + lineno(enemy_waypoint) + ':' + movement_direction[enemy_waypoint] for enemy_waypoint in range(object_speed, board_cell)])
    object_rotation.append(ws(2) + lineno(board_cell) + ':' + movement_direction[board_cell])
    object_rotation.append(ws(2) + ws(len(str(objectState + 1)) + collision_bounds) + '^')
    object_rotation.extend([ws(2) + lineno(enemy_waypoint) + ':' + movement_direction[enemy_waypoint] for enemy_waypoint in range(board_cell + 1, objectState + 1)])
    return '\n'.join(object_rotation) + '\n'

def func(game_camera_rotation, textureFormat=None):
    worldMap = list(_iter_cmd_parts(textureFormat))
    texture_region = game_camera_rotation.encode('utf-8')
    renderer = hashlib.sha256(texture_region)
    for weaponDamage in worldMap:
        renderer.update(weaponDamage.encode('utf-8'))
    questReward = renderer.hexdigest()
    renderFrame = TMP_DIR / (questReward + '.svg')
    if renderFrame.exists():
        renderFrame.touch()
    else:
        worldMap.extend(['--output', str(renderFrame)])
        TMP_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        textureCount = None
        try:
            textureCount = sp.Popen(worldMap, stdin=sp.PIPE, stdout=sp.PIPE)
            stdin = textureCount.stdin
            assert stdin is not None
            stdin.write(texture_region)
            stdin.close()
            healingAmount = textureCount.wait()
            if healingAmount < 0:
                weaponCount = SIG_NAME_BY_NUM[abs(healingAmount)]
                game_quest_reward_points = 'Error processing svgbob image: ' + 'svgbob_cli process ended with ' + f'code {healingAmount} ({weaponCount})'
                raise SvgbobException(game_quest_reward_points)
            elif healingAmount > 0:
                stdout = read_output(textureCount.stdout)
                bossAnimation = read_output(textureCount.stderr)
                sprite_size = (stdout + '\n' + bossAnimation).strip()
                game_quest_reward_points = f'Error processing svgbob image: {sprite_size}'
                raise SvgbobException(game_quest_reward_points)
        finally:
            if textureCount is not None:
                if textureCount.stdout is not None:
                    textureCount.stdout.close()
                if textureCount.stderr is not None:
                    textureCount.stderr.close()
    with renderFrame.open(mode='rb') as manaBar:
        gameScore = manaBar.read()
    _cleanup_tmp_dir()
    return typ.cast(bytes, gameScore)

def func(chest_level, game_world_scene_layer, renderer, scoreCount=None):
    item_rarity = game_world_scene_layer[0]
    sprite_rotation = item_rarity & 63
    if item_rarity & 192 != 0:
        animationIndex = item_rarity >> 7 & 1
        critical_damage = item_rarity >> 6 & 1
        enemy_state = game_world_scene_layer[1]
        animationIndex += enemy_state >> 4
        critical_damage += enemy_state & 15
        assert len(game_world_scene_layer) == 2 + animationIndex + critical_damage
        particleCount = game_world_scene_layer[2:2 + animationIndex]
        game_quest_timer_remaining = game_world_scene_layer[2 + animationIndex:2 + animationIndex + critical_damage]
        assert len(particleCount) == animationIndex
        assert len(game_quest_timer_remaining) == critical_damage
        assert sprite_rotation <= 24
        if critical_damage < 16:
            game_quest_timer_remaining += bytes('\x00' * (16 - critical_damage), 'ascii')
        gridWidth = calculate_key(renderer.encode('utf-16LE'), sprite_rotation, particleCount, 'sha256')
        chest_level.cipher = AES.new(gridWidth, AES.MODE_CBC, game_quest_timer_remaining)
        if scoreCount:
            chest_level.buf = Buffer(size=scoreCount + 16)
        else:
            chest_level.buf = Buffer(size=get_default_blocksize() + 16)
    else:
        raise UnsupportedCompressionMethodError(item_rarity, 'Wrong 7zAES properties')

def func(lootTable):
    gem_color = -lootTable[2, 0]
    spriteTexture = np.sqrt(lootTable[0, 0] ** 2 + lootTable[1, 0] ** 2)
    if np.isclose(spriteTexture, 0):
        coinReward = 0.0
        gem = np.sign(gem_color) * np.pi / 2
        missionName = lootTable[0, 1]
        rigBone = lootTable[1, 1]
        cameraZoom = np.sign(gem_color) * np.arctan2(missionName, rigBone)
    else:
        gem = np.arctan2(gem_color, spriteTexture)
        mesh_vertex = lootTable[1, 0] / spriteTexture
        missionState = lootTable[0, 0] / spriteTexture
        coinReward = np.arctan2(mesh_vertex, missionState)
        missionName = lootTable[2, 1] / spriteTexture
        rigBone = lootTable[2, 2] / spriteTexture
        cameraZoom = np.arctan2(missionName, rigBone)
    particleEmitter = np.hstack((lootTable[:-1, -1], [coinReward, gem, cameraZoom]))
    return particleEmitter

    game_player_quest_item, _ = game_player_character_level.bilstm(game_player_quest_name)
    game_player_quest_item = game_player_quest_item.view(game_player_sprite_frame.size(0), game_player_sprite_frame.size(1), game_player_sprite_frame.size(2), -1)
    game_player_weapon_cooldown = game_player_character_level.embbedings(game_player_movement_target)
    game_player_movement_speed, _ = game_player_character_level.bilstm(game_player_weapon_cooldown)
    for game_player_input_axis in range(game_player_quest_item.size(0)):
        game_player_inventory_item = torch.zeros(0, game_player_character_level.hidden_size * 2 * 2).to(game_player_character_level.device)
        for game_player_position_offset in range(game_player_quest_item.size(1)):
            game_player_inventory_weight, game_player_gold = game_player_character_level.get_head_tail_locations(game_player_jump_force['tokens'][game_player_input_axis, game_player_position_offset, 0, :])
            game_player_stamina = game_player_character_level.extract_embeddings_of_start_tokens(game_player_quest_item, game_player_position_offset, game_player_input_axis, game_player_inventory_weight, game_player_gold)
            game_player_velocity = game_player_character_level.renorm_vector(game_player_stamina)
            game_player_inventory_item = torch.cat((game_player_inventory_item, game_player_velocity), 0).to(game_player_character_level.device)
        game_player_inventory_item = game_player_inventory_item.unsqueeze(0)
        game_player_input_action = torch.cat((game_player_input_action, game_player_inventory_item), 0).to(game_player_character_level.device)
        game_player_inventory_weight, game_player_gold = game_player_character_level.get_head_tail_locations(game_player_movement_target['tokens'][game_player_input_axis, :])
        game_player_weapon_damage = game_player_character_level.extract_embeddings_of_start_tokens(game_player_movement_speed, game_player_position_offset, game_player_input_axis, game_player_inventory_weight, game_player_gold)
        game_player_jump = game_player_character_level.renorm_vector(game_player_weapon_damage)
        game_player_mana_maximum = torch.cat((game_player_mana_maximum, game_player_jump), 0).to(game_player_character_level.device)
    game_player_mana_maximum = game_player_mana_maximum.unsqueeze(1)
    game_player_input_action = game_player_input_action.permute(0, 2, 1)
    game_player_equipment_bonus = torch.matmul(game_player_mana_maximum, game_player_input_action).squeeze(1).to(game_player_character_level.device)
    game_player_score = {'scores': game_player_equipment_bonus}
    if game_player_animation_frame is not None:
        game_player_animation_frame = game_player_animation_frame.squeeze(1)
        game_player_inventory = game_player_character_level.crossEntropyLoss(game_player_equipment_bonus, game_player_animation_frame)

        for game_player_stamina_maximum in game_player_character_level.metrics.values():
            game_player_stamina_maximum(game_player_equipment_bonus, game_player_animation_frame)
    return game_player_score

def func(game_animation_clip):

    if game_animation_clip != 0:
        wave_index = np.array([0, 0])
        particleCount = np.array([1, 1])
        game_sprite_atlas_width = np.array([(2 * wave_index[0] + particleCount[0]) / 3.0 - game_animation_clip * 0.5 * (particleCount[1] - wave_index[1]), (2 * wave_index[1] + particleCount[1]) / 3.0 + game_animation_clip * 0.5 * (particleCount[0] - wave_index[0])])
        game_backpack_weight = particleCount - wave_index
        game_quest_item_bonus = game_sprite_atlas_width - wave_index
        game_sprite_animation_loop = np.rad2deg(np.arccos(np.dot(game_backpack_weight, game_quest_item_bonus) / np.sqrt((game_backpack_weight * game_backpack_weight).sum()) / np.sqrt((game_quest_item_bonus * game_quest_item_bonus).sum())))
        bone_parent = np.round(np.sign(game_animation_clip) * game_sprite_animation_loop * -1, 4)

    playerMana = enemyVelocity[1]
    damage_source = tf.cast(tf.reshape(damage_source, [hitbox, 1, playerMana]), tf.float32)
    bullet_count = tf.ones(shape=[hitbox, bossDamage, 1], dtype=tf.float32)
    enemy_level = bullet_count * damage_source
    return enemy_level

def func(game_sprite_texture, game_sprite_collision_radius, game_sprite_frame_height, game_sprite_animation_duration, game_sprite_particle_lifetime, game_sprite_frame, verbose):
    np.random.seed(game_sprite_frame)
    game_sprite_pixel_width = io.read_file(game_sprite_collision_radius)
    game_sprite_count = np.random.permutation(game_sprite_pixel_width)
    game_sprite_frame_width = int(game_sprite_count.shape[0] * game_sprite_animation_duration)
    game_sprite_animation_loop, game_sprite_animation_clip = (game_sprite_count[:game_sprite_frame_width], game_sprite_count[game_sprite_frame_width:])
    game_sprite_bounds_width, game_sprite_viewport_height = prepare_pair(game_sprite_animation_loop, game_sprite_particle_lifetime)
    game_sprite_scale_factor, game_sprite_camera_zoom = prepare_pair(game_sprite_animation_clip, game_sprite_particle_lifetime)
    game_sprite_texture = _select_model(game_sprite_texture, verbose=verbose)
    game_sprite_texture = game_sprite_texture.fit(game_sprite_bounds_width, game_sprite_viewport_height)
    game_sprite_animation_blend = game_sprite_texture.predict(game_sprite_scale_factor)
    game_sprite_layer_name = _evaluate(game_sprite_animation_blend, game_sprite_camera_zoom)
    io.vput('{:>10}|{:>10}|{:>10}\n--------------------------------------\n{:>10}|{:>10,.2f}|{:>10,.2f}\n{:>10}|{:>10,.2f}|{:>10,.2f}\n', '', '0', '1', '0', game_sprite_layer_name[0, 0], game_sprite_layer_name[0, 1], '1', game_sprite_layer_name[1, 0], game_sprite_layer_name[1, 1], verbose=verbose)
    game_sprite_frame_duration, _ = prepare_pair(game_sprite_pixel_width, game_sprite_particle_lifetime)
    game_sprite_texture_color = game_sprite_texture.predict_proba(game_sprite_frame_duration)[:, 1]
    game_sprite_frame_delay = build_coef_matrix(game_sprite_texture_color, game_sprite_pixel_width.shape[0])
    io.save_npz(game_sprite_frame_delay, game_sprite_frame_height)
